name: EPIC 245973442

text.card: A red giant 7,753 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 1.03 solar masses and 11.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,991 K at its surface.
